verdict.rationale: Morph is API-first: its documentation describes an OpenAI-compatible base URL (api.morphllm.com/v1), a native Anthropic Messages endpoint at /v1/messages, batch, Reflex training jobs, and dedicated endpoints. An llms.txt index and markdown docs are also served, and a community user confirmed hands-on that they got the OpenAI-compatible endpoint working from their own CLI tool. missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404).
